name: defra-adts
description: ADTS cross-service test tooling and E2E suite
author: ADTS-Defra

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix services/adts-ui && npm install --prefix services/adts-submissions-service && npm install --prefix services/adts-backend
scripts.dev: npm run test:db:up && npm run dev:defra-id-stub
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOCAL_DRAFT_OWNER_ID=user-456 ENTRA_WELL_KNOWN_URL=$ENTRA_WELL_KNOWN_URL LIMS_PVS_ID=PVS001 SUBMISSIONS_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3100 DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local PORT=3200 npm start --prefix services/adts-backend
scripts.dev:ui: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOCAL_DRAFT_OWNER_ID=user-456 SESSION_SECRET=local-development-session-secret-32-chars BACKEND_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3200 PORT=3000 npm start --prefix services/adts-ui
scripts.dev:submissions: cross-env PORT=3100 LIMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3300 LIMS_ALLOW_HTTP=true npm start --prefix services/adts-submissions-service
scripts.dev:down: lsof -tiTCP:3000,3100,3200,3400 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; npm run test:db:down
scripts.dev:defra-id-stub: concurrently -k -n STUB,BACKEND,UI,SUBMISSIONS -c magenta,yellow,green,cyan "npm run mock:defra-id" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ui:stub" "npm run dev:submissions"
scripts.dev:ui:stub: cross-env AUTH_PROVIDER=defra-id AUTH_MODE=live AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCAL=true DEFRA_ID_WELL_KNOWN_URL=http://localhost:3400/cdp-defra-id-stub/.well-known/openid-configuration DEFRA_ID_CLIENT_ID=63983fc2-cfff-45bb-8ec2-959e21062b9a DEFRA_ID_CLIENT_SECRET=test_value DEFRA_ID_SERVICE_ID=adts-local DEFRA_ID_POLICY=local-stub DEFRA_ID_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run dev:ui
scripts.test:services: npm run test:ui && npm run test:submissions && npm run test:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:e2e
